version: LOCK 92 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - A shelf for the House of Learning
builds_on: LOCK 5 (clothes and bags), LOCK 9 (secret giving after page 1), LOCK 23 Saeed, LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 36 roads. Founder 8 Nov picks: animals, land and buildings, businesses, waqf; marriage and family (scholar check set aside 9 Nov).

design_reference_not_shown.waqf_library: Bukhari 2737 (keep the land, give its yield)

missions.title: A shelf for the House of Learning
missions.button: Endow a shelf of books · 200 coins

a.text: The librarian explains: give the money once and it buys books that are never sold, only read, for as long as the House stands.

choices.label: Endow it in your name · 200 coins
Endow it with no name · 200 coins

named.text: A small plaque goes on the shelf with your name.

secret.text: The plaque says only: given for the sake of Allah.

named: Endowed books for the House of Learning

missions.title: A room for travellers
missions.button: Endow a free room for travellers · 250 coins

a.text: The innkeeper has a back room. Endow it, and any traveller with no coins sleeps there free, forever.

choices.label: Endow it in your name · 250 coins
Endow it with no name · 250 coins

named.text: The innkeeper paints your name above the door.

secret.text: The innkeeper paints: for travellers, for the sake of Allah.

named: Gave the inn a free room for travellers

a.text: Rahma says a bed costs 150 coins to endow: the bed, its linen, and the food for whoever lies in it, for as long as the hospital stands.

choices.label: Endow it in your name · 150 coins
Endow it with no name · 150 coins

named.text: Your name is carved on the bed's headboard.

secret.text: The headboard says only: for the sake of Allah.

named: Endowed a bed at the hospital

a.text: Thabit has found water under the south palms. A new well, endowed, would belong to no one and serve everyone.

choices.label: Endow it in your name · 120 coins
Endow it with no name · 120 coins

named.text: Thabit carves your name on the well's rim.

secret.text: Thabit carves: dug for the sake of Allah.
